COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1517 of 2021 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, Advocate, for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Narain Dutt, Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to 
inform the Court, that as a consequence of the 
affirmation of the judgment of 7th March, 2006, which 
was rendered in Writ Petition (S/S) No. 687 of 2005, 
Balak Ram Vs. State of Uttaranchal and others, the 
Coordinate Bench of this Court had directed the 
respondents to consider the grant of relaxation in the 
upper age limit, to the petitioner, to the extent of his 
period of service rendered on daily wages, after its 
affirmation by the Division Bench and later on by the 
Apex Court vide its judgement of 28th October, 2013, as 
rendered in SLP (Civil) No.(s) 13557 of 2012, what 
orders have been passed by the respondents for the 
purposes of the grant of relaxation to the petitioner for 
inclusion of the services of the petitioner for the grant 
of service benefits, including the benefit of 
regularization. 
Necessary information would be supplied by the 
petitioner within a period of one week from today. 
List after one week. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 02.12.2021
Shiv

WPSS No.1517 of 2021
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, Advocate, for 
the petitioner.
Mr. Narain Dutt, Brief Holder, for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
The petitioner to the present writ petition 
has contended, that his claim for the grant of 
age relaxation for the purposes of consideration
of his claim for regularization, was decided by 
the judgment dated 07.03.2006, which stood 
affirmed up to the Hon’ble Apex Court by the 
decision dated 28.10.2013, as rendered in SLP 
No.13557 of 2012.
The petitioner contends that despite of 
the aforesaid fact, that the age relaxation benefit 
has been extended to the petitioner, but still his 
claim for grant of regularization w.e.f. 
17.04.2005, has been wrongfully considered by 
the rejection of the claim by an order dated 
17.09.2021.
Learned counsel for the respondents 
prays for and is granted three weeks’ time to 
file counter affidavit. 
List this writ petition thereafter. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 15.12.2021
NR/
